> **About this version.** This is the team's final analysis with two
> refinements: (1) every model, from logistic regression to boosting, is
> evaluated on the same validation and test rows (Section 4.2), and
> (2) the Random Forest threshold is read from the validation ROC curve rather
> than typed in, so the results reproduce on any machine (Section 5.1).

# Data Cleaning and Preprocessing

The raw data is the NASA NeoWs 1950–2025 dataset (375,659 rows, 41 columns),
available on Kaggle as
[Near Earth Comets Classification](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/seniruepasinghe/near-earth-comets-classification-dataset).

If the raw file `data/nasa_neows_1950_2025.csv` is present, the cleaning steps
below run and produce the cleaned dataset. If it is not, the notebook loads the
already-cleaned file `data/cleaned_neows_1950_2025.xlsx` (35,430 rows), which
is the output of these same steps.

```{r raw-flag}
raw_path   <- "data/nasa_neows_1950_2025.csv"
clean_path <- "data/cleaned_neows_1950_2025.xlsx"
have_raw   <- file.exists(raw_path)
have_raw
```

## Loading the Raw Dataset

```{r load-raw, eval = have_raw}
asteroids <- read.csv(raw_path, header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
str(asteroids)
```

## Removing Missing Values

```{r remove-na, eval = have_raw}
asteroids_clean <- na.omit(asteroids)
nrow(asteroids_clean)
```

## Removing Redundant Columns

Name and Equinox are dropped in favor of Neo Reference ID, and duplicate
unit conversions are dropped to keep a single unit of measurement per quantity.

```{r redundant-cols, eval = have_raw}
asteroids_clean <- asteroids_clean[, !(names(asteroids_clean) %in% c("Name", "Equinox"))]

superfluous <- c(
  "Est.Dia.in.KM.min.", "Est.Dia.in.M.min.", "Est.Dia.in.M.max.",
  "Est.Dia.in.Miles.min.", "Est.Dia.in.Miles.max.",
  "Est.Dia.in.Feet.min.", "Est.Dia.in.Feet.max.",
  "Relative.Velocity.km.per.sec", "Miles.per.hour",
  "Miss.Dist..Astronomical.", "Miss.Dist..lunar.", "Miss.Dist..miles."
)
asteroids_clean <- asteroids_clean[, !(names(asteroids_clean) %in% superfluous)]
colnames(asteroids_clean)
```

## Filtering to Earth-Orbiting Objects

```{r earth-only, eval = have_raw}
unique(asteroids_clean$Orbiting.Body)
asteroids_clean <- asteroids_clean[asteroids_clean$Orbiting.Body == "Earth", ]
unique(asteroids_clean$Orbiting.Body)
```

## Removing Duplicate Objects

Each asteroid appears once per close approach. Keeping one row per
Neo Reference ID prevents the same object from landing in both the training
and test sets (data leakage).

```{r dedupe, eval = have_raw}
sum(duplicated(asteroids_clean$Neo.Reference.ID))
asteroids_clean <- asteroids_clean[!duplicated(asteroids_clean$Neo.Reference.ID), ]
sum(duplicated(asteroids_clean$Neo.Reference.ID))
```

## Final Null Check

```{r null-check, eval = have_raw}
asteroids_clean <- na.omit(asteroids_clean)
colSums(is.na(asteroids_clean))
```

## Loading the Cleaned Dataset (if the raw file is absent)

```{r load-clean, eval = !have_raw}
asteroids_clean <- as.data.frame(read_excel(clean_path))
# One value is stored as text in scientific notation; convert it to numeric
asteroids_clean$Minimum.Orbit.Intersection <-
  as.numeric(asteroids_clean$Minimum.Orbit.Intersection)
asteroids_clean$Miss.Dist..kilometers. <-
  as.numeric(asteroids_clean$Miss.Dist..kilometers.)
str(asteroids_clean)
```

```{r eda-corr, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 9}

```

```{r eda-pairs, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 9}
  dplyr::select(Miss.Dist..kilometers., Relative.Velocity.km.per.hr,
                Absolute.Magnitude, Orbital.Period, Minimum.Orbit.Intersection)
```

# Variable Selection: Logistic Regression, Ridge, and LASSO

## Data Preparation

```{r prep}
# Drop all non-predictive columns once for use across all models
shared_drop <- c("Date", "Neo.Reference.ID", "Close.Approach.Date",
                 "Orbit.Determination.Date", "Epoch.Date.Close.Approach",
                 "Orbit.ID", "Perihelion.Time", "Orbiting.Body")
model_data <- asteroids_clean[, !(names(asteroids_clean) %in% shared_drop)]

# Convert all predictors to numeric
predictor_names <- setdiff(names(model_data), "Hazardous")
model_data <- model_data %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(predictor_names), ~ as.numeric(as.character(.))))

# hco_data: numeric Hazardous (1/0) for logistic regression, Ridge, LASSO
hco_data <- model_data
hco_data$Hazardous <- ifelse(as.character(model_data$Hazardous) %in% c("True", "TRUE"), 1, 0)

# comets_model: factor Hazardous for Random Forest, Boosting, Bagging
comets_model <- model_data
comets_model$Hazardous <- factor(
  ifelse(as.character(model_data$Hazardous) %in% c("True", "TRUE"), "TRUE", "FALSE"),
  levels = c("FALSE", "TRUE")
)
```

## Train / Validation / Test Split

A single stratified 60/20/20 split is shared by every model.

> **Correction (post-course).** In the original notebook, the Step 2 sets were
> built with `hco_data[val_idx, ]` and `hco_data[-c(train_idx, val_idx), ]`.
> But `val_idx` holds row positions *within* `temp` (the 40% held out from
> training), not within the full dataset, so the Step 2 validation and test
> sets overlapped the training set. The lines below take `val_idx` from the
> held-out rows, so Step 2 now uses exactly the same validation and test rows
> as the ensemble models.

```{r split}
set.seed(5703)
train_idx   <- createDataPartition(comets_model$Hazardous, p = 0.6, list = FALSE)
comet_train <- comets_model[train_idx, ]
temp        <- comets_model[-train_idx, ]

val_idx    <- createDataPartition(temp$Hazardous, p = 0.5, list = FALSE)
comet_val  <- temp[val_idx, ]
comet_test <- temp[-val_idx, ]

minority_n <- min(table(comet_train$Hazardous))

# Same rows for the Step 2 models (corrected indexing)
hco_heldout         <- hco_data[-train_idx, ]
train_hco_data      <- hco_data[train_idx, ]
validation_hco_data <- hco_heldout[val_idx, ]
test_hco_data       <- hco_heldout[-val_idx, ]

# Sanity checks: no overlap, and the two versions line up row for row
stopifnot(nrow(train_hco_data) + nrow(validation_hco_data) + nrow(test_hco_data) == nrow(hco_data))
stopifnot(all(validation_hco_data$Hazardous == as.numeric(comet_val$Hazardous == "TRUE")))
stopifnot(all(test_hco_data$Hazardous == as.numeric(comet_test$Hazardous == "TRUE")))

c(train = nrow(comet_train), validation = nrow(comet_val), test = nrow(comet_test))
table(comet_train$Hazardous)
```

## Baseline Logistic Regression

```{r baseline-logit}
baseline_model_hco_data <- glm(Hazardous ~ ., data = train_hco_data, family = binomial)
summary(baseline_model_hco_data)
```

`Aphelion.Dist` has an `NA` coefficient because it is an exact linear
combination of the semi-major axis and perihelion distance.

## Best Subset Selection

```{r best-subset}
best_subset_hco_data <- regsubsets(Hazardous ~ ., data = train_hco_data,
                                   nvmax = 19, method = "exhaustive")
summary_best_subset_hco_data <- summary(best_subset_hco_data)
best_model_bic <- which.min(summary_best_subset_hco_data$bic)
coefficients_best_model <- coef(best_subset_hco_data, best_model_bic)

kable(
  data.frame(
    Vars  = 1:length(summary_best_subset_hco_data$adjr2),
    AdjR2 = round(summary_best_subset_hco_data$adjr2, 4),
    BIC   = round(summary_best_subset_hco_data$bic, 4),
    CP    = round(summary_best_subset_hco_data$cp, 4)
  ),
  caption = "Best Subset Selection Performance Metrics",
  col.names = c("Number of Variables", "Adj R-Squared", "BIC", "Mallows' Cp"),
  align = "c"
) %>% kable_styling(position = "left", full_width = FALSE)

kable(
  data.frame(Variable = sub("(Intercept)", "Intercept", names(coefficients_best_model), fixed = TRUE),
             Coefficient = round(as.numeric(coefficients_best_model), 6)),
  caption = paste("Variables Selected by Best Subset Selection (Size =", best_model_bic, ")"),
  col.names = c("Variable Name", "Estimated Coefficient"),
  align = "l"
) %>% kable_styling(position = "left", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r best-subset-plots, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 4}
par(mfrow = c(1, 3))
plot(summary_best_subset_hco_data$adjr2, xlab = "Number of Variables",
     ylab = "Adjusted R²", type = "l", main = "Adjusted R²")
points(which.max(summary_best_subset_hco_data$adjr2),
       max(summary_best_subset_hco_data$adjr2), col = "red", cex = 2, pch = 20)
plot(summary_best_subset_hco_data$cp, xlab = "Number of Variables",
     ylab = "Cp", type = "l", main = "Cp")
points(which.min(summary_best_subset_hco_data$cp),
       min(summary_best_subset_hco_data$cp), col = "red", cex = 2, pch = 20)
plot(summary_best_subset_hco_data$bic, xlab = "Number of Variables",
     ylab = "BIC", type = "l", main = "BIC")
points(which.min(summary_best_subset_hco_data$bic),
       min(summary_best_subset_hco_data$bic), col = "red", cex = 2, pch = 20)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

## Stepwise Selection (Bidirectional)

```{r stepwise}
train_hco_data$Hazardous      <- as.factor(train_hco_data$Hazardous)
validation_hco_data$Hazardous <- as.factor(validation_hco_data$Hazardous)
test_hco_data$Hazardous       <- as.factor(test_hco_data$Hazardous)

full_model_hco_data <- glm(Hazardous ~ ., data = train_hco_data, family = binomial)
stepwise_hco_data   <- stepAIC(full_model_hco_data, direction = "both", trace = FALSE)
summary(stepwise_hco_data)

kable(
  data.frame(Variable = sub("(Intercept)", "Intercept", names(coef(stepwise_hco_data)), fixed = TRUE),
             Coefficient = round(as.numeric(coef(stepwise_hco_data)), 6)),
  caption = "Variables Selected by Stepwise Selection (Bidirectional)",
  col.names = c("Variable Name", "Estimated Coefficient"),
  align = "l"
) %>% kable_styling(position = "left", full_width = FALSE)
```

## Ridge Regression

```{r ridge}
train_hco_data$Hazardous      <- as.numeric(as.character(train_hco_data$Hazardous))
validation_hco_data$Hazardous <- as.numeric(as.character(validation_hco_data$Hazardous))
test_hco_data$Hazardous       <- as.numeric(as.character(test_hco_data$Hazardous))

predictors_train_hco_data      <- as.matrix(train_hco_data[, colnames(train_hco_data) != "Hazardous"])
target_train_hco_data          <- train_hco_data$Hazardous
predictors_validation_hco_data <- as.matrix(validation_hco_data[, names(validation_hco_data) != "Hazardous"])
target_validation_hco_data     <- validation_hco_data$Hazardous

set.seed(5703)
ridge_5_fold_hco_data <- cv.glmnet(predictors_train_hco_data, target_train_hco_data,
                                   alpha = 0, family = "binomial", nfolds = 5)
ridge_lambda_min_hco_data <- ridge_5_fold_hco_data$lambda.min
ridge_lambda_1se_hco_data <- ridge_5_fold_hco_data$lambda.1se

predict_response_ridge_min <- predict(ridge_5_fold_hco_data, newx = predictors_validation_hco_data,
                                      s = ridge_lambda_min_hco_data, type = "response")
predict_response_ridge_1se <- predict(ridge_5_fold_hco_data, newx = predictors_validation_hco_data,
                                      s = ridge_lambda_1se_hco_data, type = "response")
predict_class_ridge_min    <- predict(ridge_5_fold_hco_data, newx = predictors_validation_hco_data,
                                      s = ridge_lambda_min_hco_data, type = "class")

kable(
  data.frame(
    Metric = c("Lambda.min", "Lambda.1se", "Error (min)", "MSE (min)", "MSE (1se)"),
    Value  = c(round(ridge_lambda_min_hco_data, 6),
               round(ridge_lambda_1se_hco_data, 6),
               round(mean(predict_class_ridge_min != target_validation_hco_data), 6),
               round(mean((target_validation_hco_data - predict_response_ridge_min)^2), 6),
               round(mean((target_validation_hco_data - predict_response_ridge_1se)^2), 6))
  ),
  align = "c", caption = "Ridge Regression 5-fold Cross Validation"
) %>% kable_styling(position = "left", full_width = FALSE)

ridge_fit_hco_data <- glmnet(predictors_train_hco_data, target_train_hco_data,
                             alpha = 0, family = "binomial")
plot(ridge_fit_hco_data)
title("Ridge Regression: Coefficients vs. Log(Lambda)", line = 3)

roc_lambda_min_ridge <- roc(target_validation_hco_data, predict_response_ridge_min[, 1], quiet = TRUE)
plot(roc_lambda_min_ridge, col = "blue", main = "Ridge ROC lambda.min")
legend("bottomright",
       legend = paste("Lambda.min (AUC =", round(auc(roc_lambda_min_ridge), 6), ")"))
```

## LASSO Regression

```{r lasso}
set.seed(5703)
lasso_5_fold_hco_data <- cv.glmnet(predictors_train_hco_data, target_train_hco_data,
                                   alpha = 1, family = "binomial", nfolds = 5)
lasso_lambda_min_hco_data <- lasso_5_fold_hco_data$lambda.min
lasso_lambda_1se_hco_data <- lasso_5_fold_hco_data$lambda.1se

predict_response_lasso_min <- predict(lasso_5_fold_hco_data, newx = predictors_validation_hco_data,
                                      s = lasso_lambda_min_hco_data, type = "response")

lasso_fit_hco_data <- glmnet(predictors_train_hco_data, target_train_hco_data,
                             alpha = 1, family = "binomial")
plot(lasso_fit_hco_data)
title("LASSO Regression: Coefficients vs. Log(Lambda)", line = 3)

roc_lambda_min_lasso <- roc(target_validation_hco_data, predict_response_lasso_min[, 1], quiet = TRUE)
plot(roc_lambda_min_lasso, col = "blue", main = "LASSO ROC lambda.min")
legend("bottomright",
       legend = paste("Lambda.min (AUC =", round(auc(roc_lambda_min_lasso), 6), ")"))
```

## Step 2 Model Comparison (Validation Set)

```{r step2-compare}
val_hazardous_numeric <- as.numeric(as.character(validation_hco_data$Hazardous))

best_vars <- names(coef(best_subset_hco_data, best_model_bic))
best_vars <- best_vars[best_vars != "(Intercept)"]
form_best <- as.formula(paste("Hazardous ~", paste(best_vars, collapse = " + ")))
fit_best  <- glm(form_best, data = train_hco_data, family = binomial)

pred_baseline <- predict(baseline_model_hco_data, newdata = validation_hco_data, type = "response")
pred_stepwise <- predict(stepwise_hco_data,       newdata = validation_hco_data, type = "response")
pred_best     <- predict(fit_best,                newdata = validation_hco_data, type = "response")
pred_ridge    <- predict(ridge_5_fold_hco_data, newx = predictors_validation_hco_data,
                         s = ridge_lambda_min_hco_data, type = "response")[, 1]
pred_lasso    <- predict(lasso_5_fold_hco_data, newx = predictors_validation_hco_data,
                         s = lasso_lambda_min_hco_data, type = "response")[, 1]

roc_baseline <- roc(val_hazardous_numeric, pred_baseline, quiet = TRUE)
roc_stepwise <- roc(val_hazardous_numeric, pred_stepwise, quiet = TRUE)
roc_best     <- roc(val_hazardous_numeric, pred_best,     quiet = TRUE)
roc_ridge    <- roc(val_hazardous_numeric, pred_ridge,    quiet = TRUE)
roc_lasso    <- roc(val_hazardous_numeric, pred_lasso,    quiet = TRUE)

step2_table <- data.frame(
  Method = c("Baseline (Full Logistic)", "Stepwise (Bidirectional)",
             "Best Subset", "Ridge (lambda.min)", "LASSO (lambda.min)"),
  Variables = c(length(coef(baseline_model_hco_data)) - 1,
                length(coef(stepwise_hco_data)) - 1,
                best_model_bic,
                sum(coef(ridge_5_fold_hco_data, s = ridge_lambda_min_hco_data) != 0) - 1,
                sum(coef(lasso_5_fold_hco_data, s = lasso_lambda_min_hco_data) != 0) - 1),
  AIC = c(round(AIC(baseline_model_hco_data), 4), round(AIC(stepwise_hco_data), 4),
          round(AIC(fit_best), 4), NA, NA),
  AUC = round(c(as.numeric(auc(roc_baseline)), as.numeric(auc(roc_stepwise)),
                as.numeric(auc(roc_best)), as.numeric(auc(roc_ridge)),
                as.numeric(auc(roc_lasso))), 4)
)

kable(step2_table,
      caption = "Final Model Comparison Across All Step 2 Methods (Validation Set)",
      col.names = c("Method", "Variables Used", "AIC (Training)", "AUC (Validation)"),
      align = "c") %>%
  kable_styling(position = "left", full_width = FALSE)

plot(roc_baseline, col = "black", lwd = 2, main = "ROC Curve Comparison: All Step 2 Models")
lines(roc_stepwise, col = "blue",   lwd = 2)
lines(roc_best,     col = "red",    lwd = 2)
lines(roc_ridge,    col = "green",  lwd = 2)
lines(roc_lasso,    col = "orange", lwd = 2)
legend("bottomright",
       legend = c(paste("Baseline (AUC =",    round(as.numeric(auc(roc_baseline)), 4), ")"),
                  paste("Stepwise (AUC =",    round(as.numeric(auc(roc_stepwise)), 4), ")"),
                  paste("Best Subset (AUC =", round(as.numeric(auc(roc_best)), 4), ")"),
                  paste("Ridge (AUC =",       round(as.numeric(auc(roc_ridge)), 4), ")"),
                  paste("LASSO (AUC =",       round(as.numeric(auc(roc_lasso)), 4), ")")),
       col = c("black", "blue", "red", "green", "orange"), lwd = 2)
```

# Ensemble Methods: Random Forest, Boosting, and Bagging

Each forest draws an equal number of hazardous and non-hazardous objects per
tree (`sampsize`), which balances the classes during training only. The
validation and test sets keep the real-world 93/7 class ratio.

## Random Forest

### Model 1: Baseline Random Forest

```{r rf1}
set.seed(5703)
comet_rf_model <- randomForest(
  Hazardous ~ ., data = comet_train, ntree = 500,
  mtry = floor(sqrt(ncol(comet_train) - 1)),
  sampsize = c("FALSE" = minority_n, "TRUE" = minority_n),
  importance = TRUE
)
comet_preds <- predict(comet_rf_model, newdata = comet_val)
confusionMatrix(comet_preds, comet_val$Hazardous, positive = "TRUE")
```

### mtry Tuning via OOB Error

```{r rf-tune}
set.seed(5703)
comet_tuned <- tuneRF(
  x = comet_train[, -which(names(comet_train) == "Hazardous")],
  y = comet_train$Hazardous,
  stepFactor = 1.5, improve = 0.01, ntreeTry = 300, trace = TRUE, plot = TRUE
)
```

### Model 2: Tuned mtry with Class Weights

```{r rf2}
set.seed(5703)
comet_rf_model_tune <- randomForest(
  Hazardous ~ ., data = comet_train, ntree = 500, mtry = 4,
  sampsize = c("FALSE" = minority_n, "TRUE" = minority_n),
  classwt = c("FALSE" = 1, "TRUE" = 10),
  importance = TRUE
)
comet_preds_1 <- predict(comet_rf_model_tune, newdata = comet_val)
confusionMatrix(comet_preds_1, comet_val$Hazardous, positive = "TRUE")
```

### Model 3: Lowered Classification Threshold

```{r rf3}
set.seed(5703)
comet_rf_model_tune_1 <- randomForest(
  Hazardous ~ ., data = comet_train, ntree = 500, mtry = 4,
  sampsize = c("FALSE" = minority_n, "TRUE" = minority_n),
  importance = TRUE
)
pred_probs_1 <- predict(comet_rf_model_tune_1, newdata = as.data.frame(comet_val), type = "prob")
pred_class_1 <- factor(ifelse(pred_probs_1[, "TRUE"] >= 0.15, "TRUE", "FALSE"),
                       levels = c("FALSE", "TRUE"))
confusionMatrix(pred_class_1, comet_val$Hazardous, positive = "TRUE")
```

### Model 4: ROC-Optimized Threshold (Final RF Model)

Rather than guessing a cutoff, the threshold is read directly from the
validation ROC curve: the point that best balances sensitivity and
specificity (Youden's index). The same method is used for boosting below.

```{r rf4}
set.seed(5703)
comet_rf_model_tune_2 <- randomForest(
  Hazardous ~ ., data = comet_train, ntree = 500, mtry = 4,
  sampsize = c("FALSE" = minority_n, "TRUE" = minority_n),
  importance = TRUE
)

pred_probs_2 <- predict(comet_rf_model_tune_2, newdata = as.data.frame(comet_val), type = "prob")

roc_rf_val   <- roc(comet_val$Hazardous, pred_probs_2[, "TRUE"], quiet = TRUE)
rf_threshold <- coords(roc_rf_val, "best", ret = "threshold", transpose = FALSE)$threshold[1]
plot(roc_rf_val, print.thres = "best", print.auc = TRUE,
     main = "Random Forest: Optimal Threshold of Validation Set")
cat("Optimal Threshold Cutoff:", rf_threshold, "\n")

pred_class_2 <- factor(ifelse(pred_probs_2[, "TRUE"] >= rf_threshold, "TRUE", "FALSE"),
                       levels = c("FALSE", "TRUE"))
confusionMatrix(pred_class_2, comet_val$Hazardous, positive = "TRUE")
```

### Final RF Test Set Evaluation

```{r rf-test}
pred_probs_3 <- predict(comet_rf_model_tune_2, newdata = as.data.frame(comet_test), type = "prob")
pred_class_3 <- factor(ifelse(pred_probs_3[, "TRUE"] >= rf_threshold, "TRUE", "FALSE"),
                       levels = c("FALSE", "TRUE"))
confusionMatrix(pred_class_3, comet_test$Hazardous, positive = "TRUE")
```

## Gradient Boosting

### Data Recoding for Boosting Compatibility

caret needs class labels that are valid R names, so TRUE/FALSE become Yes/No.

```{r boost-recode}
recode_yes_no <- function(d) {
  d$Hazardous <- factor(ifelse(d$Hazardous == "TRUE", "Yes", "No"), levels = c("No", "Yes"))
  d
}
comet_train_boost <- recode_yes_no(comet_train)
comet_val_boost   <- recode_yes_no(comet_val)
comet_test_boost  <- recode_yes_no(comet_test)
```

### Model Training: 5-Fold CV with Grid Search

Down-sampling is applied inside each training fold only, and the list of
seeds makes the grid search reproducible.

```{r boost-train}
set.seed(5703)
gbm_grid <- expand.grid(interaction.depth = 1:5,
                        n.trees = seq(100, 600, by = 100),
                        shrinkage = c(0.001, 0.01, 0.1),
                        n.minobsinnode = c(10, 20))

n_models <- nrow(gbm_grid)
setSeeds <- vector(mode = "list", length = 6)
for (i in 1:5) setSeeds[[i]] <- sample.int(100000, n_models)
setSeeds[[6]] <- sample.int(100000, 1)

fitControl <- trainControl(method = "cv", number = 5, classProbs = TRUE,
                           summaryFunction = twoClassSummary,
                           sampling = "down", seeds = setSeeds)

model_boost <- train(Hazardous ~ ., data = comet_train_boost,
                     method = "gbm", distribution = "bernoulli",
                     trControl = fitControl, tuneGrid = gbm_grid,
                     metric = "ROC", verbose = FALSE)
```

### Optimal Tuning and Variable Importance

```{r boost-best}
model_boost$bestTune
plot(varImp(model_boost), top = 10, main = "Boosting: Variable Importance")
```

### Validation Set ROC: Threshold Selection

Because the model trained on 50/50 down-sampled folds, its predicted
probabilities run high for a dataset where only 7% of objects are hazardous.
That is why the ROC-optimal cutoff lands well above 0.5.

```{r boost-threshold}
probs_boost_val <- predict(model_boost, newdata = comet_val_boost, type = "prob")[, "Yes"]
roc_boost_val   <- roc(response = comet_val_boost$Hazardous, predictor = probs_boost_val, quiet = TRUE)
plot(roc_boost_val, print.thres = "best", print.auc = TRUE, col = "blue",
     main = "ROC: Optimal Threshold of Validation Set")

optimal   <- coords(roc_boost_val, "best", ret = c("threshold", "specificity", "sensitivity"),
                    transpose = FALSE)
threshold <- optimal$threshold[1]
cat("Optimal Threshold Cutoff:", threshold, "\n")
```

### Validation Set Evaluation

```{r boost-val}
preds_boost_val <- factor(ifelse(probs_boost_val >= threshold, "Yes", "No"), levels = c("No", "Yes"))
cm_boost_val    <- confusionMatrix(preds_boost_val, comet_val_boost$Hazardous, positive = "Yes")
cm_boost_val
cat("ROC-AUC:", round(auc(roc_boost_val), 4), "\n")
```

### Test Set Evaluation

```{r boost-test}
probs_boost_test <- predict(model_boost, newdata = comet_test_boost, type = "prob")[, "Yes"]
preds_boost_test <- factor(ifelse(probs_boost_test >= threshold, "Yes", "No"), levels = c("No", "Yes"))
cm_boost_test    <- confusionMatrix(preds_boost_test, comet_test_boost$Hazardous, positive = "Yes")
cm_boost_test

roc_boost <- roc(response = comet_test_boost$Hazardous, predictor = probs_boost_test,
                 levels = c("No", "Yes"), direction = "<", quiet = TRUE)
ROC_AUC <- round(auc(roc_boost), 4)
cat("ROC-AUC:", ROC_AUC, "\n")

plot(roc_boost, col = "forestgreen", main = "ROC Curve: Gradient Boosting (Test)", lwd = 2)
```

## Bagging

Bagging is a random forest that considers every predictor at each split
(`mtry = p`).

### Model Fitting: 100, 300, 500 Trees

```{r bag-fit}
p <- ncol(comet_train) - 1

set.seed(5703)
bag_100 <- randomForest(Hazardous ~ ., data = comet_train, mtry = p, ntree = 100,
                        sampsize = c("FALSE" = minority_n, "TRUE" = minority_n), importance = TRUE)
set.seed(5703)
bag_300 <- randomForest(Hazardous ~ ., data = comet_train, mtry = p, ntree = 300,
                        sampsize = c("FALSE" = minority_n, "TRUE" = minority_n), importance = TRUE)
set.seed(5703)
bag_500 <- randomForest(Hazardous ~ ., data = comet_train, mtry = p, ntree = 500,
                        sampsize = c("FALSE" = minority_n, "TRUE" = minority_n), importance = TRUE)
bag_100
bag_300
bag_500
```

### OOB Error Plots

```{r bag-oob}
plot(bag_100, main = "Bagging OOB Error: 100 Trees")
plot(bag_300, main = "Bagging OOB Error: 300 Trees")
plot(bag_500, main = "Bagging OOB Error: 500 Trees")
```

### Validation Set Comparison

```{r bag-val}
get_classification_metrics <- function(model, newdata, truth_col = "Hazardous",
                                       positive_class = "TRUE", threshold = 0.5) {
  pred_prob  <- predict(model, newdata = newdata, type = "prob")[, positive_class]
  pred_class <- factor(ifelse(pred_prob >= threshold, "TRUE", "FALSE"), levels = c("FALSE", "TRUE"))
  cm <- confusionMatrix(pred_class, newdata[[truth_col]], positive = positive_class)
  roc_obj <- roc(response = newdata[[truth_col]], predictor = pred_prob,
                 levels = c("FALSE", "TRUE"), direction = "<", quiet = TRUE)
  data.frame(
    Accuracy    = as.numeric(cm$overall["Accuracy"]),
    Precision   = as.numeric(cm$byClass["Pos Pred Value"]),
    Recall      = as.numeric(cm$byClass["Sensitivity"]),
    Specificity = as.numeric(cm$byClass["Specificity"]),
    F1          = as.numeric(cm$byClass["F1"]),
    AUC         = as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))
  )
}

# A deliberately low threshold: an object is flagged if even 2.5% of trees vote
# "hazardous". This prioritizes recall (missing a hazardous object is the costly
# error) at the price of more false alarms. It is chosen on validation and
# reused unchanged on the test set.
bag_threshold <- 0.025

validation_results <- rbind(
  cbind(Model = "Bagging_100", get_classification_metrics(bag_100, comet_val, threshold = bag_threshold)),
  cbind(Model = "Bagging_300", get_classification_metrics(bag_300, comet_val, threshold = bag_threshold)),
  cbind(Model = "Bagging_500", get_classification_metrics(bag_500, comet_val, threshold = bag_threshold))
)
kable(validation_results, caption = "Bagging Validation Set Results", align = "c", digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(position = "left", full_width = FALSE)
```

### Final Bagging Model: Test Set Evaluation

The same threshold chosen on the validation set is applied to the test set.

```{r bag-test}
final_bag      <- bag_300
bag_pred_prob  <- predict(final_bag, newdata = comet_test, type = "prob")[, "TRUE"]
bag_pred_class <- factor(ifelse(bag_pred_prob >= bag_threshold, "TRUE", "FALSE"),
                         levels = c("FALSE", "TRUE"))
bag_cm <- confusionMatrix(bag_pred_class, comet_test$Hazardous, positive = "TRUE")
bag_cm

bag_roc <- roc(response = comet_test$Hazardous, predictor = bag_pred_prob,
               levels = c("FALSE", "TRUE"), direction = "<", quiet = TRUE)
bag_auc <- as.numeric(auc(bag_roc))
bag_auc

plot(bag_roc, col = "blue", main = "ROC Curve - Bagging Model")
varImpPlot(final_bag, main = "Variable Importance - Final Bagging Model")
```

```{r cm-all}
rf_cm <- confusionMatrix(pred_class_3, comet_test$Hazardous, positive = "TRUE")

cat("=== Random Forest - Test Confusion Matrix ===\n"); print(rf_cm$table)
```

## ROC Curve Comparison

```{r roc-all}
roc_rf  <- roc(comet_test$Hazardous, pred_probs_3[, "TRUE"], levels = c("FALSE", "TRUE"), quiet = TRUE)
roc_bag <- roc(comet_test$Hazardous, bag_pred_prob,          levels = c("FALSE", "TRUE"), quiet = TRUE)

plot(roc_rf, col = "blue", lwd = 2,
     main = "ROC Curve Comparison: RF vs Bagging vs Boosting", legacy.axes = TRUE)
lines(roc_bag,   col = "darkgreen", lwd = 2)

       legend = c(paste("Random Forest (AUC =", round(auc(roc_rf), 4), ")"),
                  paste("Bagging (AUC =",       round(auc(roc_bag), 4), ")"),

       col = c("blue", "darkgreen", "red"), lwd = 2)
```

## Metrics Comparison Table

```{r compare-table}
ens_row <- function(cm, auc_value) {
  c(Accuracy    = round(cm$overall["Accuracy"], 4),
    Sensitivity = round(cm$byClass["Sensitivity"], 4),
    Specificity = round(cm$byClass["Specificity"], 4),
    Kappa       = round(cm$overall["Kappa"], 4),
    F1          = round(cm$byClass["F1"], 4),
    AUC         = round(auc_value, 4),
    FN          = cm$table[1, 2],
    FP          = cm$table[2, 1])
}

comparison_table <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Random Forest", "Bagging", "Boosting"),
  rbind(ens_row(rf_cm, as.numeric(auc(roc_rf))),
        ens_row(bag_cm, bag_auc),
        ens_row(cm_boost_test, as.numeric(ROC_AUC)))
)
names(comparison_table) <- c("Model", "Accuracy", "Sensitivity", "Specificity",
                             "Kappa", "F1", "AUC", "FN", "FP")

kable(comparison_table, caption = "Final Model Comparison: Test Set Performance", align = "c") %>%
  kable_styling(position = "center", full_width = FALSE)
```

## Variable Importance Comparison

```{r imp-all}
rf_imp <- importance(comet_rf_model_tune_2) |> as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column("Variable") |> dplyr::select(Variable, MeanDecreaseGini) |>
  mutate(Model = "Random Forest")
bag_imp <- importance(final_bag) |> as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column("Variable") |> dplyr::select(Variable, MeanDecreaseGini) |>
  mutate(Model = "Bagging")
boost_imp <- varImp(model_boost)$importance |> as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column("Variable") |> rename(MeanDecreaseGini = Overall) |>
  mutate(Model = "Boosting")

all_imp  <- rbind(rf_imp, bag_imp, boost_imp)
top_vars <- all_imp |> group_by(Variable) |>
  summarise(AvgImportance = mean(MeanDecreaseGini)) |>
  arrange(desc(AvgImportance)) |> slice_head(n = 10) |> pull(Variable)

all_imp |>
  filter(Variable %in% top_vars) |>
  mutate(Variable = reorder(Variable, MeanDecreaseGini)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = MeanDecreaseGini, y = Variable, fill = Model)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Variable Importance Comparison Across Models",
       x = "Mean Decrease Gini / Importance", y = "Variable") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Random Forest" = "blue", "Bagging" = "darkgreen", "Boosting" = "red"))
```

## All Models on the Test Set

Step 2 sensitivity and specificity are taken at each model's ROC-optimal point.

```{r all-models, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 5}
predictors_test_hco_data <- as.matrix(test_hco_data[, names(test_hco_data) != "Hazardous"])
target_test_hco          <- as.numeric(as.character(test_hco_data$Hazardous))

pred_baseline_test <- predict(baseline_model_hco_data, newdata = test_hco_data, type = "response")
pred_stepwise_test <- predict(stepwise_hco_data,       newdata = test_hco_data, type = "response")
pred_best_test     <- predict(fit_best,                newdata = test_hco_data, type = "response")
pred_ridge_test    <- predict(ridge_5_fold_hco_data, newx = predictors_test_hco_data,
                              s = ridge_lambda_min_hco_data, type = "response")[, 1]
pred_lasso_test    <- predict(lasso_5_fold_hco_data, newx = predictors_test_hco_data,
                              s = lasso_lambda_min_hco_data, type = "response")[, 1]

roc_baseline_test <- roc(target_test_hco, pred_baseline_test, quiet = TRUE)
roc_stepwise_test <- roc(target_test_hco, pred_stepwise_test, quiet = TRUE)
roc_best_test     <- roc(target_test_hco, pred_best_test,     quiet = TRUE)
roc_ridge_test    <- roc(target_test_hco, pred_ridge_test,    quiet = TRUE)
roc_lasso_test    <- roc(target_test_hco, pred_lasso_test,    quiet = TRUE)

get_best_coords <- function(roc_obj, metric) {
  round(as.numeric(coords(roc_obj, "best", ret = metric, transpose = FALSE)[1, ]), 4)
}

step2_rocs <- list(roc_baseline_test, roc_stepwise_test, roc_best_test, roc_ridge_test, roc_lasso_test)

all_models_table <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Baseline Logistic", "Stepwise", "Best Subset", "Ridge", "LASSO",
            "Random Forest", "Bagging", "Boosting"),
  AUC = c(sapply(step2_rocs, function(r) round(as.numeric(auc(r)), 4)),
          round(as.numeric(auc(roc_rf)), 4), round(bag_auc, 4), as.numeric(ROC_AUC)),
  Sensitivity = c(sapply(step2_rocs, get_best_coords, metric = "sensitivity"),
                  round(rf_cm$byClass["Sensitivity"], 4),
                  round(bag_cm$byClass["Sensitivity"], 4),
                  round(cm_boost_test$byClass["Sensitivity"], 4)),
  Specificity = c(sapply(step2_rocs, get_best_coords, metric = "specificity"),
                  round(rf_cm$byClass["Specificity"], 4),
                  round(bag_cm$byClass["Specificity"], 4),
                  round(cm_boost_test$byClass["Specificity"], 4))
)
kable(all_models_table, caption = "All Models: Test Set", align = "c") %>%
  kable_styling(position = "center", full_width = FALSE)

all_models_long <- pivot_longer(all_models_table, cols = -Model, names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value")
all_models_long$Model <- factor(all_models_long$Model, levels = all_models_table$Model)

ggplot(all_models_long, aes(x = Model, y = Value, fill = Model)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Value, 3)), vjust = -0.3, size = 2.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ Metric, ncol = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.85, 1.02), oob = scales::squish) +
  labs(title = "Model Performance Comparison: All Models (Test Set)", x = NULL, y = "Value") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none")
```
